question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Quiet
solution: The correct answer is **"Commotion."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Quiet** means absence of noise or disturbance. (शांत, ख़ामोश) • **Example**: *She spoke in a **quiet**__ voice so as not to wake him.* • So, its antonym should be** "Commotion."** • **Commotion** means a state of confusion or noisy disturbance. ((शोरग़ुल, उत्तेजना, हुल्‍लड़, गड़बड़ी)) __ • **Example**: *His arrival caused quite a **commotion**__.* • The correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 - Stillness **- It means the absence of movement, not necessarily noise. (निश्‍चलता, शांति) • **Option 3 - Compose** - It means to create something, usually music or writing. (घटकों का अपने से बड़ी वस्‍तु को बनाना) • **Option 4** - **Completely **- It means fully or entirely. (सब तरह से; पूरे तौर पर; संपूर्ण रूप से) 32:Tc5b, The correct answer is **"face."**
